verse.verse_3: Does man think that We cannot [resurrect him and] bring his bones together again?
verse.verse_4: Indeed, We have the power to restore his very finger tips!
verse.verse_5: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
verse.verse_6: he asks, "When is this Day of Resurrection to be?"
verse.verse_7: But [on that Day], when mortal sight is confounded,
verse.verse_9: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
verse.verse_10: on that Day man will ask, "Where can I escape?"
verse.verse_11: But there is nowhere to take refuge:
verse.verse_12: on that Day, to your Lord alone is the recourse.
verse.verse_13: On that Day, man will be told of all that he has sent before and what he has left behind.
verse.verse_14: Indeed, man shall be a witness against himself,
verse.verse_15: in spite of all the excuses he may offer.
verse.verse_16: [Prophet], do not move your tongue too fast in your attempt to learn this revelation:
verse.verse_17: We Ourself shall see to its collection and recital.
verse.verse_18: When We have recited it, follow its words attentively;
verse.verse_19: and then, it will be for Us to make its meaning clear.
verse.verse_22: Some faces will be radiant on that Day,
verse.verse_24: and some faces will on that Day be gloomy,
verse.verse_26: But when [man's soul] reaches the throat,
verse.verse_27: and when it is asked: "Could any magician save him now?";
verse.verse_28: and he knows that it is the time of parting;
verse.verse_29: when his legs are brought together [when affliction is combined with affliction];
verse.verse_30: on that Day he will be driven towards your Lord!
verse.verse_32: but rejected the Truth and turned away!
verse.verse_33: Then he went off to his people, swaggering.
verse.verse_34: Woe to you, [O man!], yes, woe to you.
verse.verse_35: Again, woe to you, [O man!], yes, woe to you!
verse.verse_36: Does man, then, think that he is to be left to himself, to go about at will?
verse.verse_37: Was he not once a drop of ejaculated semen,
verse.verse_38: which then became a leech-like clot; then God shaped and fashioned him in due proportion,
verse.verse_39: fashioning out of him the two sexes, the male and the female?
verse.verse_40: Then is He not able to bring the dead back to life?
